statements.t: By bringing together two leaders with highly complementary technologies, exceptional talent and specialized manufacturing capabilities, we intend to help shape the next era of AI connectivity and create exceptional stockholder value.”
Together with Marvell, we will meet our customers’ complete interconnect needs, spanning scale-across and scale-out today to scale-up and scale-in domains tomorrow.
By offering extreme co-design around our customers’ demanding requirements, we will help them achieve faster time to market, accelerated innovation cycles, and category-defining performance.”

risks.t: the outcome of any legal proceedings related to the Transaction
the anticipated tax treatment of the transaction
the possible diversion of management’s time and attention from ongoing business operations and opportunities
the ability of the parties to consummate the Transaction on a timely basis or at all
the occurrence of any event, change or other circumstance that could give rise to a right to terminate the Transaction
the ability to successfully integrate Marvell’s and Lumentum’s operations and business on a timely basis or otherwise
the amount of the costs, fees, expenses and charges related to the Transaction
the cash needs and availability of financing for Marvell and Lumentum in connection with, or following the completion of, the Transaction
fluctuations in the prices of Marvell or Lumentum stock
potential business disruptions following the Transaction
